title: DiaVLo: Diagnosing Behaviours of Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.22008v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) rely on storing and transferring appropriate information across their sub-components. Verifying that the VLMs exhibit desired behaviours, while avoiding harmful ones, is central to their reliable deployment. Yet, methods that identify VLM behaviours remain scarce. We present DiaVLo, a diagnostic framework that leverages human curation and VLMs' generation capabilities to construct specifications of desired and observed VLM behaviours, surfacing potential misalignments. Beyond this, DiaVLo also provides causal estimates to identify the most influential concepts steering VLM behaviours. We evaluate DiaVLo on several open-source VLMs under both classification and generation conditions. Our experiments show that DiaVLo produces behaviour labels that correlate with model performance and provide context for measured performance. DiaVLo surfaced behaviours that are clearly aligned and misaligned, alongside patter

translated_title: DiaVLo：诊断视觉-语言模型的行为
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）依赖于在其子组件之间存储和传递适当的信息。验证VLMs表现出期望的行为、同时避免有害的行为，是其可靠部署的核心。然而，识别VLM行为的方法仍然稀缺。我们提出了DiaVLo，这是一个诊断框架，它利用人工筛选和VLM自身的生成能力来构建期望行为与观察到的VLM行为的规范，从而揭示潜在的错位现象。除此之外，DiaVLo还提供因果估计，以识别引导VLM行为的最具影响力的概念。我们在分类和生成两种条件下对多个开源VLMs评估了DiaVLo。实验表明，DiaVLo产生的行为标签与模型性能相关，并为测得的性能提供了背景解释。DiaVLo揭示了明显对齐和错对齐的行为，以及相应的模式。
tldr: DiaVLo是一个诊断框架，通过结合人工筛选与VLM生成能力构建行为规范，揭示视觉-语言模型的潜在错位行为，并提供因果估计以识别引导模型行为的关键概念。
en_tdlr: DiaVLo is a diagnostic framework that combines human curation with VLM generation capabilities to construct behavior specifications, revealing potential misalignments in vision-language models and providing causal estimates to identify the most influential concepts steering model behaviors.
